description: Work out the federal payroll tax dates for one payroll date. Send your federal deposit schedule (monthly or semiweekly) and the payroll date (the day wages are paid), and say if $100,000 or more of tax built up that day. Get back the Form 941 tax deposit due date, the quarter's Form 941 due date (and the later date if every deposit was made in full and on time), the quarter's Form 940 FUTA deposit date, the annual Form 940 date and the W-2 and W-3 date for that year, with weekends and Washington, D.C. legal holidays applied and each shift explained. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/payroll-tax-deadlines-us). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

deposit_schedule.description: Your federal tax deposit schedule for the year (monthly or semiweekly), as the IRS assigned it from your lookback period.

label.description: Optional label for the payroll run (your own text, echoed back; not a person).

payroll_date.description: The day wages are paid, YYYY-MM-DD (2021 to 2050).

reached_100k.description: true if $100,000 or more of employment tax built up on the payroll date (the next-day deposit rule). Default false.
